title: Nvidia authorizes USD 150 billion increase to Nvidia stock buyback
key_facts: NVIDIA announced on 28 Sep 2026 that its board authorized an additional USD 150 billion under its existing share repurchase program
Total remaining under the program rose to USD 235 billion, per the NVIDIA Newsroom
Lang & Schwarz quoted Nvidia stock at EUR 207.85 in weekend trading on 4 Oct 2026, unchanged versus the 2 Oct close
quote_evidence: On September 28, 2026, NVIDIA announced that its board had authorized an additional USD 150 billion under the company's existing share repurchase program, according to the NVIDIA Newsroom.
The NVIDIA Newsroom said the additional authorization increased the total remaining amount under the program to USD 235 billion.
why_it_matters_hint: The buyback authorization is large but was announced a week before this article.
notes: Older news: the authorization was announced 28 Sep 2026; the 4 Oct article is mostly a weekend share-price note (EUR 207.85 at Lang & Schwarz, unchanged). Company announcement relayed by AD HOC NEWS; the NVIDIA Newsroom page itself was not opened.
